WHEN WILL THAT TAP STOP DRIPPING????????????????????????? Drip, drip, drip. I can feel the itch starting again; the itch that has to be scratched. I MUST GET STRONGER. You think Eddie's invisible, do you? You think you can just look at your feet and walk on by? Nobody listens to Eddie. But you will. You will hear my silence and feel my breath. Je suis un monstre.
zh: 在MyRoom上还是没有好友，尽管我已经努力地把个人资料写得平易近人了。人们不理解埃迪，埃迪也不理解他们。埃迪有过一个女朋友，她被关进了地下室。实际上，她一定还在那里。也许是因为我是独生子吧。不管怎样，现在我是了。他们在池塘里找到了埃迪的弟弟。傻逼水龙头啥时候消停????????????????????????? 滴，滴，滴个不停。我又感觉到痒了，那种不挠不行的痒。我必须更强大。你当埃迪是空气，对吗？你觉得低着头就能直接走过去吗？没人听埃迪说话，但你会。你将听见我的沉默，感受到我的呼吸。我是怪物。

english: It's time for me to speak to the world. To tell you who I am. To be famous, like I will be. I thought that the Internets were just for buying breast milk but I'm learning that they're so much more. All these millions of shadowy figures jostling for visibility. Are you alone in the dark waiting for Eddie? I'm finally starting to feel part of something; that I'm wired into a cosmos, a COMMUNITY. Eddie's never had any friends, except for Boo Boo Wilkins. I hate that cat. I hate that cat. I hate that cat. Always wailing and whining and wanting to be petted. I'll pet you, Boo Boo Wilkins - with a fucking cheese grater!!!!!! NO! Eddie would never hurt Boo Boo Wilkins.
zh: 我现在该向全世界演说了，告诉你们我是谁，就此一举成名(这是必然的)。原本我以为互联网只是用来购买母乳的，但现在我知道了，互联网的意义远远不止这些。上百万争夺曝光的模糊身影啊，你们是否都在黑暗中独自等待埃迪的降临？我现在终于找到了一丝归属感，有了我属于这个小宇宙、属于这个社群的感觉。埃迪一直没有朋友，除了Boo Boo 威尔金斯。我讨厌那只猫我讨厌那只猫我讨厌那只猫。一直在哭叫、呜咽，等着被抚摸。我会抚摸你的，Boo Boo 威尔金斯！用刨丝器抚摸你!!!!!! 不！埃迪永远都不会伤害Boo Boo 威尔金斯。

english: Eddie slept in the garden last night. Oh, what fun! What delightful fun! Under the apple tree. Then the birds starting chirping, drilling into my head with their messages of doom and subversion. I remember playing in that tree as a boy. Little Eddie with his little peanut. Look at Low! It's like a maggot! How I hated those showers. So many schools, so many showers, so many people to find. Remember me, Pennington? Remember me, Owens? Remember me, Dodson? Eddie is all grown up now and wants to show you what he knows about musculoskeletal manipulation. The itch is getting worse. What day is it? Tuesday? Friday? Is it fish today, mother? Must get out for a wander. Scratch that itch.
zh: 埃迪昨晚睡在花园里。哦，多么有趣！多么令人愉快！躺在苹果树下，鸟儿开始叽叽喳喳，带着厄运和颠覆即将降临的信息钻进我的脑袋。我还记得小时候在那棵树上玩耍的经历。小埃迪和他的小花生。「看看洛！跟条蛆一样！」我讨厌开放式澡堂。这么多学校，这么多喷头，这么多人。还记得我吗，彭宁顿？还记得我吗，欧文斯？还记得我吗，多德森？埃迪已经长大了，他想让你见识下他对肌肉骨骼的操作。痒得更厉害了。今天星期几？星期二？还是星期五？妈妈，今天是钓鱼日吗？必须得出去走走了，解痒。

english: The thought of you reading my weblog is quite a turn-on I can tell you. Trust me, it's not true. I make it all up, just like they make up where little boys and little girls come from. Lots of things turn me on - trepanation, armadillos, yeast infections - but I have to learn to control myself. Mother caught Eddie pumping devil paste out of his peanut one day and made me sleep in the dog kennel. I never liked that dog. The way it looked at me when I made it lick jam off my peanut. Those judging eyes. I made a finger puppet out of its esophagus. Nobody has contacted me on MyRoom yet. I just want to meet a nice girl. Or a boy. Where was Eddie tonight? Why am I in mother's nightgown?
zh: 我可以告诉你，一想到有人读我的博客，我就很兴奋。相信我，都是假的，文章内容都是我瞎编的，就像他们编造小宝宝是从哪里来的一样。能让我兴奋的东西很多，比如头部穿孔、犰狳、酵母菌感染，但我必须学会控制自己。有一天，妈妈发现埃迪从他的花生里榨出了邪恶的黏液，她就让埃迪去睡狗窝。我一直不喜欢那条狗。不喜欢我让它舔掉我花生上的果酱时的它的眼神，那种评头论足的眼神。我用它的食道做了个手指布偶。还是没有人在MyRoom上联系我。我只是想认识一个好女孩。或是好男孩。今晚埃迪在哪儿？为什么我穿着妈妈的睡裙？

english: That Detective Atkinson is a moron. He'll never catch me. He can't even come up with a name for me. All he's interested in is getting his picture in the newspaper. I'm supposed to be the one getting the attention! Everybody thinks they can ignore Eddie. Well, maybe I am invisible. Maybe you can't see me. But another head is looking me straight in the eye right now. This is just the beginning, Atkinson. Complacency. Apathy. Indulgence. Is this what humanity has come to? Is this the civilization for which man was destined? If so, I don't want to be part of it. The gene pool is polluted. You do not deserve life. You make me want to puke. In fact, I'm going to.
zh: 阿特金森警探是个白痴。他永远抓不到我。他连我的外号都起不出来。他只对在报纸上露脸感兴趣。明明我才是该得到公众注意的人！所有人都觉得他们可以无视埃迪。好吧，也许我是隐形的，也许你们看不到我。但现在又有一颗人头在直视我的眼睛。这只是个开始，阿特金森。自满、冷漠、放纵，这就是人类的现状吗？这就是人类注定走向的文明吗？如果是这样，我不接受这种文明。基因库被污染了。你不应该活着，你让我想吐。实际上，我确实要吐了。

english: The bombs have been placed. They will detonate in 60 seconds. Get off the ship.
zh: 炸弹已安置，炸弹将于60秒后引爆，快离开这艘船。

english: ~z~Yeah. All sorts of sickos can use the internet. You have to be careful. I'm Niko.
zh: ~z~是啊，什么混蛋都能上网，你一定要小心。我是尼克。

english: ~z~Niko! It's me. I've got a date for you with this guy today at 8am. Have fun.
zh: ~z~尼克！是我啊，我给你安排了一场今天8点的约会，玩得开心一点。

english: ~z~Call me up. My number never existed. No. I'm not too worried about that.
zh: ~z~打电话找我，根本没这号码。不，我不必担心被人揭发。

english: ~s~Get in a cop car. Your contact has left one across the street from the U. L. Paper office.
zh: ~s~进入一辆警车，你的联系人已经在U. L. Paper办公室的对街留了一辆给你。

english: ~z~Yo. Yo. Yo. Yo. Niko, it's Brucie baby.
zh: ~z~哟，哟哟哟。尼克，是我布鲁斯，宝贝。

english: ~z~A rocket launcher. It's in the back. Get rid of the chopper with it. I'll drive the boat.
zh: ~z~火箭发射器，就在后头。拿它把那架直升机打下来，船我替你开。

english: ~z~Here we are. Got him here in one piece. That was the deal. Thanks, Niko.
zh: ~z~我们到了，把他安全护送到这儿了。就这点事，谢了，尼克。

english: I hereby make you a minority shareholder in R.B.E. - I'm the C.E.O. - we're in business, cousin!
zh: 特此吸收你为罗曼･贝利克集团的小股东，我可是CEO，这下我们都迈上正轨了，堂弟！

english: I find bike. I steal it. I bring it back. -N
zh: 我至，我偷，我得手。-N

english: Come on. You're acting crazy. You aren't being watched by government spies. Your phone isn't tapped. You don't need to drink that bottled water or eat from those tins because no one wants to poison you. Please get that into your head. Anyway, of course I'll meet you. I'll be outside the jewellery shop off Tulsa Street later on.
zh: 拜托，别发疯了。你没被政府特工监视，手机也没被窃听。没人会来毒杀你的，所以也没必要坚持喝瓶装水、吃罐头了。请你脑子清醒点。算了，我当然会来见你。待会儿我在塔尔萨街的珠宝店门口等你。

english: Word in the village is that Roman was killed on wedding day. I know it is true, as I checked on internet. My son, my heart is broken. Please leave evil place. Please go somewhere safe. Please do not caught up in madness. Please do not become statistic.
zh: 村子里说罗曼在婚礼上被杀了。我知道这是真的，我在网上查到了。我的儿子，我的心都碎了。离开这个邪恶的地方吧，找个安全的地方。请不要陷入疯狂，不要让死亡人数再多一个。

english: . He is still the same - a little fat boy who makes things up and whom everybody loves. it has been interesting in this country. Like home, only with food and more anxiety. s ljubavlju, Your loving son.
zh: 他还是老样子，还是那个爱编故事却又讨人喜欢的小胖子。这个国家的生活挺有意思，跟老家差不多，只是不愁吃喝，而且烦恼更多。s ljubavlju (爱你)，你亲爱的儿子。

english: Dear mother, thanks for your mail. Life in America is okay, thank you for your concern. I wish Roman would join me from his time spent living in clouds. He makes things up, I don't know why. He has a nice woman in his life, that is true, the rest is lies. Apart from Florian Cravic. We have seen him. He is very different.
zh: 亲爱的妈妈，谢谢你的来信。我在美国的生活还好，多谢你的关心。希望罗曼能离开他的幻想国度，回到现实中来。也不知道为什么，他就喜欢胡扯。他是找到了一个好女人，这句没错，剩下都是编的。我们也见到弗洛里安･克拉维克了，他变化好大。

english: thank you for your e mail. It made me cry. At least you are well and happy. I know you cannot live here and be well. I hope happiness finds you. Look after cousin. He is good boy. I dream of both of you settling down with nice women. It is what his mother would have wanted, as well. I will write soon.
zh: 谢谢你的邮件，读得我两眼泪汪汪，至少你现在很幸福。我知道你回老家住没法过日子。希望你能遇见幸福。照顾好你堂兄，他是个好孩子。希望你们都能找到真爱，安定下来，罗曼的母亲也会这么想的。我会再写信给你的。

english: Dear mother, thanks for your mail. Life in America is okay, thank you for your concern. I wish Roman would join me from his time spent living in clouds. He makes things up, I don't know why. He has a nice woman in his life, that is true, the rest is lies. Apart from Florian Cravic. We have seen him. He is very different.
zh: 亲爱的妈妈，谢谢你的来信。我在美国的生活还好，多谢你的关心。希望罗曼能离开他的幻想国度，回到现实中来。也不知道为什么，他就喜欢胡扯。他是找到了一个好女人，这句没错，剩下都是编的。我们也见到弗洛里安･克拉维克了，他变化好大。

english: So, after all that, you found a heart, eh? Good for you. Now, move on. Give up this life you have chosen. The net is closing in on a bunch of your colleagues and associates. I would not want you to get caught up in what is sure to be a bloody business.
zh: 所以说，这么长时间过去，你终于找回人性了，嗯？恭喜你啊。现在，该前进了，放弃以往的生活方式吧。你那些同伙就要被一网打尽了，我不希望你在这场血雨腥风中一并被捕。

english: So, you got what you wanted. I hope you feel better now. Now, give up this life you have chosen. It's over. Get married. Take up golf. Do anything, but the net is closing in, people are getting desperate. Its time to move on.
zh: 好了，你的目标已经实现了，希望你现在感觉好点了。现在，放弃以往的生活方式吧，那已经是过去式了。找个老婆，打打高尔夫，做点别的事。这边已经要收网了，他们的灭亡是无可避免的。你该向前迈进了。

english: Good seeing you, Niko! Try to stay out of trouble. You seemed kind of worn out. I hope things are not serious. I keep haring about the Eastern European crime wave and I hope you are not tangled up in this mess. Let me know if I can help.
zh: 很高兴再见到你，尼克！尽量别被卷入麻烦，你看上去就很疲倦，希望情况没那么糟。我一直听说城里有东欧系的犯罪浪潮，希望那些事跟你无关。需要我帮忙就说一声。

english: How you doing? Did you decide to stay in Liberty City? How's your cousin? I stayed. I heard everyone did. Did you hear about poor Captain. Poor man. He turned up dead and drunk in the river. And everyone else jumped ship? I wonder what those Chinese guys did with that heroin they were supposedly smuggling?
zh: 你最近好吗？有没有留在自由城？你堂哥怎么样？我留下来了，听说船上的人都留下来了。那个船长真是可怜啊，太可怜了，他喝醉酒掉河里淹死了。船上的其他人好像都跳船了？不知道那些中国人最后是怎么处理走私来的海洛因的。

english: Ummm, hello. WTF. Where were you? I booked my Indonesian dog sitter and didn't even leave Valentino alone. In the end I told her she wasn't getting any money and should walk back across the bridge to Dukes. There are thousands of potential dog sitters on the other side of the Humboldt. Why's she think she's special. Anyway, you should probably fuck her or another one of those outer borough dog sitting fat bitches. That's all you're worth. I'm champagne and you're dogshit!
zh: 呃，你好。WTF？你人呢？我连我的印尼裔狗保姆都找来了，让她陪我的瓦伦蒂诺。最后只能告诉她这次的工作吹了，让她自己步行过桥走回公爵区。洪堡河对岸有的是能当狗保姆的人，她当自己是什么了？总之，你还是找她那样的乡下肥婆干炮吧，你只配和这种人交往。如果说我是香槟酒，你就是一坨狗屎！

english: You call yourself a gentleman. How'd you let Carmen get hurt like that? I know men who would take a bullet for Carmen, men who'd put their heads under trucks for her. How come she gets hurt on a date with you! You better look after her when you go out again. Her place is on Valdez in Bohan. Get there
zh: 你自称绅士，居然会让卡门伤成这样？我认识心甘情愿为卡门挡子弹、被车撞的男人，却没想到会在跟你约会的时候受伤！下次出去的时候你最好对她好一点。她住在波汉的瓦尔德斯街。

english: Photo sharing is epic. It is the future. Swapping. Imagine. With strangers!
zh: 劲爆！分享图片才是未来。与陌生人分享照片、想象世界！

english: ~z~Mr. Faustin wants those TVs. You do not want him to take out his anger on your cousin. Go.
zh: ~z~福斯汀先生想要这批电视。你不想让他把怒气发泄在你堂兄身上的话就去把这批电视弄到手。

english: ~z~You can't even hit him in the leg. He has learned at least. Let's go.
zh: ~z~你一点也不能打他的腿，你看他至少知道了轻重，我们走吧

english: ~z~I'm just in this for the bitches, I don't wanna get hurt! Please. Please. Come on.
zh: ~z~我只是为了那些婊子，我并不想伤到谁！拜托拜托，走啊。

english: ~z~I'll take this one. Charge Mr. Faustin.
zh: ~z~我要这个，钱找福斯汀先生要。

english: ~z~I'm special, I'm gonna be a star. Don't hurt me. A big, big star!
zh: ~z~我很特别，我会成为明星的，别伤害我，我是一颗闪亮的明星！

english: ~z~Listen, big guy. You got a great look going on, real strong. We could put you in one of our films.
zh: ~z~听着，大块头，你看起来很棒，力大无比，你可以来参演我们的片子。

english: ~z~I told you to shoot him in the leg. It matters little. Let's get out of here.
zh: ~z~我都跟你说了你开枪打他的腿，不过都没关系了，我们赶紧走吧。

english: ~z~Pick out what you like. Tell them to put it on Mr. Faustin's account.
zh: ~z~挑个你喜欢的，跟店员说记在福斯汀先生账上。

english: ~z~Very good. I'm proud of you. Good.
zh: ~z~很好，我很欣赏你，好。

english: ~z~I'm sorry Niko. Thank you. At least you are loyal. We will work together again, come to see me at my house.
zh: ~z~我很抱歉尼克，谢谢你，至少你是忠诚的，我们会再次一起工作，来我家找我。

english: ~z~Shut up Dimitri, I don't care who he is. It is too late anyway. Niko has killed him. Stop your whining.
zh: ~z~迪米特里，能消停会吗，我不在乎他是谁，反正已经太晚了，尼克都杀了他了。别抱怨了。

english: ~z~You were in charge of security. Good job. Well done, Dimitri.
zh: ~z~安全方面是你负责的，干得好，真是好，迪米特里。

english: ~z~Hey, Lenny. Mr. Faustin thinks you're a rat. He ain't taking no risks.
zh: ~z~嘿，莱尼。福斯汀先生认为是你泄的密，他不会接受这个风险。

english: ~z~My father cannot control who I see. Me and Jason are together no matter what. This is love.
zh: ~z~我父亲不能决定我约谁，我和杰森无论如何都要在一起，这就是爱。

english: ~z~That place is a fucking joke, the alley slopes. Shit. You got lucky with that slant my friend. Ok?
zh: ~z~这家球馆有问题，球道不是平的。妈的，你只是在斜坡上运气好点，好吧？

english: ~z~I'm an animal on fire. I'm crazy. Loco. Lunatic. Look, all I'm saying, man,
zh: ~z~我是一头燃烧着的野兽。我疯狂、狂热、癫狂。听好，我要说的就是，兄弟，

english: ~z~Powerboats. That's some bling shit, NB. Let's roll. Pick me up in the next hour.
zh: ~z~开快艇，再炫酷不过了，NB。来吧，一小时内来找我。

english: ~z~Hey man, it's Dwayne. I've got to start doing some other shit, having some fun. I used to really enjoy bowling. You wanna come with me?
zh: ~z~喂，兄弟，我是德维恩，我现在想换换心情，找点乐子。我以前很喜欢打保龄球，你想一起来吗？

english: ~z~I thought you must have lost my number, son. Been a long time. Too long. Don't matter.
zh: ~z~我还以为你把我的号码弄丢了，老弟。你太久没找我了，不过没关系。

english: ~z~Sorry Packie. No bowling. I got shit to do. Maybe some other time.
zh: ~z~抱歉，派奇，没空打保龄球。我事很多，还是下次吧。

english: ~z~Alright. I feel like watching stuff blow up. You got a bomb for me?
zh: ~z~好吧，我有点想把什么东西炸飞，你能给我弄个炸弹吗？

english: ~z~You must have happy memories of your time here with the late Mr. Faustin. Isn't that right, cousin?
zh: ~z~你在这儿肯定有和福斯汀先生一起的美好回忆，对不对，堂弟？

english: ~z~Me? I'm always the same. You know me. I'm an optimist. Life is always great.
zh: ~z~我？一如既往。你也懂我，我是乐观主义者，生活一直都很好。

english: ~z~I can do this. Live this life. I cannot live another. Not now.
zh: ~z~我可以这样，过这种日子。我没法过别的生活，现在不行。

english: ~z~I don't know. I lost contact. I think he went to Britain. Or to University. I don't know.
zh: ~z~不知道，我联系不上他。我觉得他去英国了，要么上大学去了。我不知道。

english: ~z~Listen man. I'm worried about you. You have to sort your life out. Before it ends.
zh: ~z~听着老弟，我很担心你。你必须要整顿一下你的生活，在它结束以前。

english: ~z~No. I will go on forever. This is my curse.
zh: ~z~不会，我会一直这样，这是我的诅咒。

english: ~z~No, you listen, you dumb immigrant fuck. I ain't asking you. I'm telling you. Do this!
zh: ~z~不，你听着，白痴移民崽子。我不是在求你，这是命令，你照做！

english: ~z~No. I need you to get that H. I need the money.
zh: ~z~不，我需要你去拿白粉，我需要钱。

english: ~z~Get after him. Come on, Niko. Get that motherfucker.
zh: ~z~追上去，快点，干死那个狗娘养的。

english: ~z~Seen, bredren. I and I be after him. Ain't no way de boy gwan live another day upon dis earth. Seen?
zh: ~z~对，兄弟，能找到他的。那小子不可能在这世上多活一天，懂？

english: ~z~Mr. Bellic. This is Karen from Goldberg, Ligner and Shyster.
zh: ~z~贝利克先生，我是戈德堡、林纳和舒斯特律师行的卡伦。

english: ~z~Mr. Bellic. This is Karen from Goldberg, Ligner and Shyster.
zh: ~z~贝利克先生，我是戈德堡、林纳和舒斯特律师行的卡伦。

english: ~z~Mr. Goldberg, Mr. Bellic has arrived for his interview.
zh: ~z~戈德堡先生，贝利克先生来参加面试了。

english: ~z~Mr. Bellic. This is Karen from Goldberg, Ligner and Shyster.
zh: ~z~贝利克先生，我是戈德堡、林纳和舒斯特律师行的卡伦。

english: ~z~Mr. Bellic, welcome. I'll just see if Mr. Goldberg is available.
zh: ~z~贝利克先生，欢迎。我要先确认戈德堡先生是否有空。

english: ~z~Mr. Goldberg, Mr. Bellic has arrived for his interview.
zh: ~z~戈德堡先生，贝利克先生来参加面试了。

english: ~z~Mr. Bellic, welcome. I'll just see if Mr. Goldberg is available.
zh: ~z~贝利克先生，欢迎。我要看一下戈德堡先生是否有空。

english: ~z~Mr. Goldberg is such a saint. He teaches kids to swim, you know?
zh: ~z~戈德堡简直是个圣人，他还教小孩子们游泳，你知道吗？

english: ~z~Mr. Bellic. This is Karen from Goldberg, Ligner and Shyster.
zh: ~z~贝利克先生，我是戈德堡、林纳和舒斯特律师行的卡伦。

english: ~z~Mr. Bellic. This is Karen from Goldberg, Ligner and Shyster.
zh: ~z~贝利克先生，我是戈德堡、林纳和舒斯特律师行的卡伦。

english: ~z~I'll get out the game. Get a GED or some shit. Make something of my life.
zh: ~z~我会退出游戏，去考个GED之类的，让人生有所成就。

english: ~z~No, no, no, no. You sent me to kill one guy. One guy who would put you in prison.
zh: ~z~不不不不，你只让我去杀一个人，那人能把你送进监狱。

english: ~z~One more. The guy's a fucking lowlife. He means nothing.
zh: ~z~再说，那货就是个劣等人，屁都不算的。

english: ~z~Making a fool of himself. Betraying people. Going into hiding.
zh: ~z~自己出尽洋相，背叛别人，跑路躲起来。

english: ~z~Dammit. We're some back doors light, Niko. The fucking casket better not fall out. Go easy.
zh: ~z~干他，我们现在后门大开，尼克。那口棺材最好别掉出来，好好开车。

english: ~z~I'm here to see Mr. Gravelli. I was sent by a mutual friend.
zh: ~z~我来找格拉韦利先生，是一个旧相识派我来的。

english: ~z~This country is falling apart. There's no law anymore. Jesus.
zh: ~z~这个国家正在分崩离析，哪有什么法律可言，天哪。

english: ~z~I know. You're power. You're masculinity. You're freedom. In some ways, you're my muse.
zh: ~z~我知道。你就是力量，就是阳刚，就是自由。某种意义上，也是我的创作源泉。

english: ~z~This story is marketable. It could be the arc my novel needs. It might give everything structure. Do you want to get married?
zh: ~z~这个故事肯定很叫座，可以作为我小说的主线，说不定能撑起故事的架构。你想结婚吗？

english: ~z~Look at you. You're inane. Ha fucking ha. Inane. That's a new word. I learnt another new word - preposterous, and that's what you are..
zh: ~z~瞧瞧你，你真驽钝。呵呵，驽钝。新学的词。还有一个呢，荒谬，说的就是你...

english: ~z~I don't know, honey. I like boys. I like looking good. I like watching TV.
zh: ~z~不知道，甜心。我喜欢男人，喜欢自己好看，还喜欢看电视。

english: ~z~It's over. This life of yours. You can change. At least think about it.
zh: ~z~就这样了，你的这种生活。你可以改变的，至少考虑一下吧。

english: ~z~No. Not really. I was trying to be more optimistic. My shrink tells me I need to be more optimistic
zh: ~z~不，不算太好。只是想更乐观点，医生让我想得开一点，

english: ~z~This is disgraceful Niko. I'm going to call the D.A. right away.
zh: ~z~真是太无耻了，尼克，我这就给地方检察官打电话。

english: ~z~I love you. I need you. I want to feel you.
zh: ~z~我爱你，离不开你，我想见你。

english: ~z~You're so beautiful, Niko. Both inside and out. You're amazing.
zh: ~z~你真的好帅，尼克，从里到外都是，你好棒。

english: ~z~Sorry, Kiki. I didn't see the time. I'll speak to you later.
zh: ~z~对不起，琪琪，我没看到时间，待会儿再和你说。

english: ~z~Ummm. We'll talk later. I'll call you.
zh: ~z~嗯...等下再说吧，我等下打给你。

english: ~z~If you want new shoes, Niko. I can buy them. Don't spend your own money.
zh: ~z~如果你想换新鞋，尼克，我帮你买，别花你自己的钱。

english: ~z~Sorry, Niko. I didn't realize it was going to take this long. I don't think I've got time for this. Can you take me home?
zh: ~z~对不起，尼克，没想到这次约会会这么久，我想我不能多陪了。你能送我回家吗？

english: ~z~Niko. My schedule is pretty tight at the moment. I can't really wait around for you. Let's go.
zh: ~z~尼克，我的安排真的很紧，真的等不了太久的，赶紧走吧。

english: ~z~It's not bad luck Niko. It's the system. It's totally fucked. Totally.
zh: ~z~这不是倒霉，尼克，是体制问题。体制烂了，完全烂了。

english: ~z~There's something special going on here. Can't you feel it? When you're inside me, Niko.
zh: ~z~我的身上有种奇妙的变化，你没感觉到吗？你我结合的时候，尼克，

english: ~z~I hate myself. I do. And I want to die.
zh: ~z~我恨我自己，我想去死。

english: ~z~Fair enough. That is his business. But I am not a drug dealer. What made you think that?
zh: ~z~行吧，那是他的事。但我不是毒贩，你怎么想到问我的？

english: World affairs. Importing and exporting goods. Free market competition.
zh: 国际事务、商品进出口、自由市场竞争。

english: ~z~Get to the side of the road, you kidnapping S. O. B.
zh: ~z~靠边停车，你这个送妈绑架犯。

english: ~z~Screw that. I got close to knocking her teeth out. That was about it. We ain't got shit now.
zh: ~z~放屁，我差点没把她的牙给打下来。就是这样，我们现在屁都没了。

english: ~z~Mr. Pegorino, I don't know what you're talking about. I came as quickly as I could.
zh: ~z~佩戈里诺先生，我不知道你在说什么，我已经尽可能快地赶过来了。

english: ~z~Shit, I told you he had his eyes open. He'll be on the lamb now. Dammit.
zh: ~z~该死，我告诉过你他一直保持警惕着，他马上就要告发我了，操。

english: A Lawyer, Tom Goldberg, was murdered in his high security Algonquin office today. Mr. Goldberg was believed to be engaged in pursuing corruption charges against high ranking members of the LCPD along with several members of City Hall. Previously, Mr. Goldberg had been involved in cases against the mafia, class action suits against food companies and also won a case against the Strike Lite match company for failing to put a warning on their matches that the product could cause fire if used correctly. In a moment of hubris, he also unsuccessfully sued God for letting it rain on his parade. The killer gained entrance to the offices of Goldberg, Ligner and Shyster where Mr. Goldberg was a partner. Dick Shyster, another partner in the firm, eulogized Mr. Goldberg in a press release, "Tom will be sorely missed by all the people he got off. I'll be taking over a lot of his cases, so hopefully I'll get a media profile as big as his and eventually run for political office myself."
zh: 今日，辩护律师汤姆･戈德堡于其高安保标准的阿尔冈琴事务所遇害。据悉，戈德堡先生曾对LCPD高官和几名市政厅官员发起腐败指控。戈德堡先生此前经办过针对黑手党的诉讼、针对食品公司的集体诉讼，他还以未在火柴包装上写明「正确使用本品会产生火焰」为由起诉Strike Lite火柴公司，并且赢下了这场诉讼。其最傲慢的时刻当属控告上帝在其游行庆祝时下雨。犯人侵入了戈德堡等人共同经营的戈德堡、林纳和舒斯特律师行。律师行的合伙人Dick 舒斯特在新闻通稿中称赞了戈德堡先生：「在汤姆帮助下得到减刑或无罪判决的委托人将会沉痛悼念他。之后我会接手他留下的大部分案子，因此我也很有希望获得他那样优秀的媒体形象，之后还能自己参选政治职位。」

english: Keep-fit fanatic and chief executive and founder of Eris Sportswear, Pete Vassal, has been checked into rehab after admitting a chronic addiction to steroids. Mr. Vassal, the man famed as having the best abs of anyone running a BAWSAQ company, attributed his fitness to a punishing exercise regime. Now it emerges that Mr. Vassal also was a serious 'juicer', consuming a wide variety of steroids and doping products, including the deadly bull shark testosterone, a form of the male hormone so strong it induces terrifying rages and mood swings in all who take it. Mr. Vassal had only recently spoken out against performance-enhancing drugs in sport.
zh: 健身爱好者、Eris运动服饰的CEO和创始人皮特･瓦萨尔，承认自己对类固醇成瘾已久，随后他被送入戒毒所。瓦萨尔先生以拥有BAWSAQ上市公司高管中最好的腹肌闻名，他将这一成就归功于刻苦锻炼。现在看来，瓦萨尔先生也是一个严重的「药罐子」，他使用了多种类固醇和兴奋剂药品，包括致命的牛鲨睾酮，这是一种雄性荷尔蒙，其强度之大，会让服用它的人感到无比愤怒，情绪极易波动。瓦萨尔先生直到最近才公开反对在体育比赛中使用兴奋剂。

english: Police were called to the Little Bay area of Bohan to resolve a domestic dispute between Steve Leeds, 48, and Mr. Doodles, 3, an American shorthair calico cat which was charged with defecating in public and vandalism of Mr. Leeds's garden. Mr. Leeds told reporters that his garden, "Totally smells like cat shit."
zh: 警方接到报警，住在波汉的小湾区的48岁老先生史蒂夫 利兹和年仅3岁的美国短毛印花猫Doodles先生发生了一起民事纠纷，Doodles先生被指控两项罪名：随地大小便以及破坏史蒂夫 利兹先生的花园。利兹先生告诉记者，他的花园「弥漫着猫屎味儿。」

english: Today, the LCPD is hungry for blood. They're out to find a killer who took one of their own, Deputy Police Commissioner Francis McReary. McReary was gunned down in a small courtyard park in Algonquin. He was apparently killed with a high-caliber rifle shot from some distance. McReary's recent career has been mired in controversy. Some news outlets claim they have evidence of bribe-taking and corruption by Mr. McReary, claims he strongly denied until his death. In an unrelated incident his brother, Gerald McReary, a convicted felon, was recently arrested again on racketeering charges.
zh: 今天，LCPD的所有人都红了眼，他们倾尽全力地寻找杀害警局副局长弗朗西斯･麦克雷里的凶手。麦克雷里在阿尔冈琴的一个小公园里遭到枪击。他显然是被远处的一杆大口径狙击步枪所杀。最近麦克雷里的警察生涯深陷泥潭，一些媒体称他们掌握了麦克雷里先生腐败受贿的证据，而麦克雷里先生生前对此坚决否认。在另外一起与此案无关的事件中，他有重罪前科的弟弟格里･麦克雷里，最近又因为涉黑被捕。

english: Elizabeta Torres, a drug dealer from South Bohan, was handed a record prison sentence at the Civic Citadel yesterday. Liberty City Judge, Mitt Burrows, slapped her with a 300 year stretch for thirty counts of cocaine distribution. It is also believed that Torres murdered Bohan community leader, Manny Escuela, and documentary film maker, Jay Hamilton. They have been missing for several weeks but police cannot bring charges until their bodies are discovered. The District Attorney submitted hundreds of hours of surveillance audio in the trial. These tapes provided evidence of her working with international drug rings. The last tape before her arrest, played at her trial yesterday, features a heated conversation between her, a Jamaican man and an Eastern European man. Authorities have been unable to locate either of these individuals.
zh: 伊丽莎贝塔･托雷斯是一名来自南波汉的毒贩，昨日米特･伯罗斯法官在市政厅对其以30项关于贩卖可卡因的指控判处300年有期徒刑，刷新了司法史上的判刑纪录。托雷斯还被怀疑涉嫌谋杀波汉的社区领袖曼尼･埃斯库埃拉和纪录片制作人杰･汉密尔顿，两人均已失踪数个星期。目前警方尚未发现这两人的尸体，无法对其提出谋杀指控。地方检察官在庭审中提交了数百小时的监听录音带，为证明托雷斯涉嫌参与跨国走私毒品提供了证据。昨日庭审中还播放了托雷斯被捕前的最后一卷录音，录音内容是其与一名牙买加男性和一名东欧男性的激烈争吵。目前有关部门仍未找到这两人。

english: In the old days it was the Pavanos vs. The Gambettis or the Ancelottis vs. the Lupicellas in a bloody war for control of various rackets within the city. Now it's all happening again. This time it is thought to also include mobsters from Alderney, who have broken away from the five families and are seeking political parity with them. Who knew mobsters were such social climbers? Well, crime expert Jimmy Cast for starters. He told us, "Mobsters are all vain - this war is not only a war for financial power, it is also a war for social control over the city. Expect more bodies to turn up before things calm down. The Alderney mob are known to be lawless and I imagine the older families will also be nervous as the DA's office uses this as an opportunity to indict several mobsters across the city in another massive crackdown on organized crime." Mayor Ochoa said, "We are close to eradicating this menace once and for all. From now on, only big businesses and the government should rob our people."
zh: 过去，为了控制本市的地下产业，帕瓦诺家族和甘贝蒂家族拼得你死我活，安切洛蒂家族和卢皮切拉家族争得头破血流。现在这一幕再度上演，而且似乎还有来自奥尔德尼的黑帮加入战斗，这个黑帮断绝了与五大家族间的关系，谋求与五大家族平起平坐。没想到这年头黑帮都这么上进了啊？犯罪专家吉米･卡斯特给出了他的观点：「帮派分子都自命不凡，这场战争不仅是经济上的战争，更是抢夺自由城控制权的战争。事态平息之前只会有更多的尸体出现。奥尔德尼的黑帮无法无天，而地方检察署也会利用这一机会，在巨大的打击行动中对五大家族的某些成员提出指控，令五大家族备受压力。」奥乔亚市长则表示：「很快我们就能一劳永逸地解决这种威胁了。从今往后，只有大企业和政府才能掠夺我们的人民。」

english: It appears that the final line of defense against identity crime has been breached, leaving the man on the street more vulnerable than ever before. You have read the news. You have seen the TV ads. Identity theft can happen to anybody, anytime, anywhere. Stay off the internet. Don't buy off foreigners. Pay cash for your porn. This is one war that you are going to have to fight on your own.
zh: 看来身份盗窃犯罪的最后一道防线业已土崩瓦解，让普通人比以往更易受到伤害。新闻你也读了，电视宣传你也看了。身份盗窃可能在任何时间、任何地点，在任何人身上发生。远离网络，别向外国人买东西，买黄片的时候付现金。这是一场必须由你独自战斗的战争。

english: The serial killer who has been beheading joggers and other people foolish enough to go out late at night on their own has struck again. This time, it's the same old story. A young victim found in a sports bag. No head. And cops left rubbing theirs, as they wonder what to call him. Detective Jon Atkinson, who has been on the case since the beginning, made the following statement: "It's a great tragedy. People are focusing on the wrong things. Until the general public starts to focus on what matters, we don't have a chance of catching this guy. People are going to have to tell me: do they want the movie to be serious, or have a comic twist? Should I have a love interest? What about my partner? Will he be older and wiser, but close to retirement, a man who dies in the penultimate scene? Or a young punk, who needs a wisecracking older guy to show him the ropes? I'm really struggling with my first draft of this screenplay, and people are just going to have to be patient."
zh: 一直斩首慢跑者和其他深夜独行白痴的连环杀手再次袭击，这次犯罪和他的往次犯罪没有差别。警方在旅行袋中发现了一具年轻人的尸体，没有头部。对于如何称呼这名连环杀手，警方依然摸不着头脑。对此，一直负责本案的乔恩･阿特金森警探表示：「这实在是悲剧。人们一直不能找到正确的关注点，在他们找到正确的关注点前，我们是不可能抓住凶手的。必须让人们告诉我：『电影要拍得严肃点，还是搞笑点？需要给我安排爱人吗？我的同伴该怎么设计？是一个年迈睿智即将退休，但会死在倒数第二幕的老头子；还是一个需要老顽童传授经验的小伙子？』我最近在绞尽脑汁地考虑剧本初稿，人们还需要耐心等待。」

english: We lived for months in a city divided. Some of us loved it. Bridge and tunnel types in the city were no more. It was great. You could go out again on a Saturday night. You felt important, like you were living in a war zone, only nothing bad happened. You thought of yourself as a survivor. Then they took it all away. They callously opened the bridges. The city returned to normal. I for one had nothing to talk about. Now the city is still a mess, only its issues are too complex for me to grasp. One urban planner has suggested that, given the chronic traffic and crime problems in the city, the best thing to do would be to close the bridges and tunnels again. I for one agree. I need something to talk about.
zh: 我们在一座分裂的城市中生活了数月，但也有人喜欢那种状态。来自乡下的通勤族不复存在，那样很好。周六晚上又可以出门了。你感觉自己有了价值，有如在战区生存，不过这里不会有灾厄降临。你把自己当作生存者。随后这一切都被夺走，大桥被无情地解封，城市回归了正常。对此我不作评价。现在这座城市仍然一团糟，只是它现在的问题过于复杂，我无法理解。一位城市规划师建议，考虑到城里长期存在的交通问题和犯罪问题，最优解是再次关闭桥梁和隧道。这我同意，我需要能评价的东西。

english: Nightlife king, "Gay" Tony Prince spoke out yesterday after he had two clubs closed by the city. He said that the city should not try to turn itself into a version of the Midwest. Mr. Prince, who has run clubs in the city for 25 years, been to rehab 5 times, and also incarcerated for tax evasion, commented, "I don't have a traditional family. I don't care about family values. That's why l live and work in Liberty City. If I wanted to go to bed at 8pm and worry about noise and hate people who weren't identical to me, I would go and live in Ohio. Nothing against Ohio. I went there once. I just used it as an example. Liberty City is supposed to be threatening and dangerous and challenging. Right now, it's about as challenging as a dog show." The LCPD spokesman we interviewed noted, "Mr. Prince's clubs were violating 8 city ordinances, and were undoubtedly places where drugs were being consumed. He is lucky he is not back in jail."
zh: 夜生活之王「基佬」托尼･普林斯经营的两家夜店被当局勒令停业。昨天他对此事进行了表态，称自由城不应成为中西部的翻版。普林斯先生在自由城经营夜店已有25年，被判5次强制戒毒，还曾因逃税而被监禁。他评论说：「我没有传统的家庭，我不在乎家庭观念，所以我才在自由城生活、工作。如果才八点我就想睡了，一边还担心噪音、讨厌那些跟我不同的人，我就会选择搬到俄亥俄住。我不是要抹黑俄亥俄，那里我去过一次，我只是拿它举个例子。自由城应该具有威胁、富于危险、充满挑战。现在，自由城的挑战水平大概跟狗狗秀差不多。」我们采访的LCPD发言人指出：「普林斯先生的夜店违反了8项城市条例，而且我们确定他的夜店是吸毒场所。没把他抓回监狱已经是他走运了。」

english: In a horrifying turn of events, a man has been murdered at his own wedding in Suffolk. The groom, Roman Bellic, 31, was a business-owner currently living in Middle Park East. His bride, Mallorie Bellic, was unavailable for a statement. Witnesses report that a man approached the wedding party outside the church, shot Mr. Bellic, and then turned the gun on himself. Mr. Bellic's cousin, Niko, was reported to have left the scene soon after the murder. He is being sought for questioning in the case but not as a suspect. Speculation is rife as to the motive of this crime. The killer may have been a jilted lover, a terrorist, a man driven mad by violent video games or the member of a sick death cult.
zh: 婚礼本该通向幸福，然而在萨福克的一个教堂，新郎在自己的婚礼上惨遭杀害。被害人罗曼･贝利克今年31岁，是一名居住在中央公园东的小老板。他的新娘玛洛丽･贝利克目前拒绝接受采访。据目击者陈述，一名男子来到了举办婚礼的教堂门口，枪杀了贝利克先生，然后开枪自尽。贝利克先生的堂弟尼克在谋杀发生后离开了现场。警方正在寻找他进行询问，但并不会将其视为嫌疑人。关于本案的动机目前有多种猜测，凶手可能刚刚失恋，也可能是恐怖分子，抑或是暴力电子游戏的受害者，或者是死亡邪教的信徒。

english: Mr. Crane needed somewhere to live so I foolishly allowed him to use an apartment I had the keys to. I was not kissing him. He had something in his eye." Mr. Dawkins has not resigned.
zh: 克兰先生需要住处，于是我就愚蠢地允许他住进了一间我有钥匙的公寓。我并不是在亲他，是他眼睛里有东西。道金斯先生仍未辞职。

english: Arch conservative and political gay basher, Bryce Dawkins, was yesterday hiding in rehab after he was discovered to have a double life. As well as a wife and children, Mr. Dawkins also had a boyfriend whom he kept in an apartment that the city financed. Photographs have emerged of Mr. Dawkins kissing Bernie Crane, his guest. Mr. Dawkins released a statement that read, "I am 100% heterosexual. Things look bad, but the evidence is just circumstantial. I do however have a substance abuse problem, which I am dealing with and I also have been addicted to bad behaviors, including visiting lap dancing clubs. I love women. Look at my wife. She's satisfied. Please leave my family alone. We need privacy. I (will) continue to stand up for what I believe in, even if I am just a man and a work in progress. I'm not gay and I never have been. Quite the opposite. I just have a soft spot for sad people who need looking after.
zh: 极端保守派兼政坛男同抨击者，布莱斯･道金斯，被指婚外恋情后于昨日躲进了康复中心。家有一妻一儿的道金斯先生还在市财政补贴的公寓中藏了一个男友。道金斯先生亲吻他的客人伯尼･克兰的照片已经流出。他发表声明称：「我是百分之百的异性恋。看起来确实不对，但这份证据只是间接的。我确实是有酗酒一类的问题，但我正在戒除，我也有一些难戒的坏习惯，比如去脱衣舞俱乐部。我喜欢女人，瞧瞧我的妻子吧，她很满足。请不要打扰我的家人，我们需要隐私。我(会)继续支持我的信条的，尽管我只是个不完美的普通人。我现在不是同性恋，以前也不是。恰恰相反，我只是无法拒绝需要照顾的伤心人。」

english: Mr. Crane needed somewhere to live so I foolishly allowed him to use an apartment I had the keys to. I was not kissing him. He had something in his eye." Mr. Dawkins has not resigned.
zh: 克兰先生需要住处，于是我就愚蠢地允许他住进了一间我有钥匙的公寓。我并不是在亲他，是他眼睛里有东西。道金斯先生仍未辞职。

english: Mob Boss, Jon Gravelli, alleged head of the Gambetti crime family, died peacefully in his sleep last night. Mr. Gravelli, 85, had been residing at the Schottler Medical Center for the last 3 years. Although some in the DA's office argued that this was a ruse to avoid a court case, Mr. Gravelli never left hospital after being admitted. Mr. Gravelli has been head of the Gambetti crime syndicate since 1978 and under his stewardship, the family had become the most powerful of Liberty City's crime families, rivaling the Pavano family. Although he had been indicted several times, Mr. Gravelli was never convicted of a serious crime. Some believed he had contacts within the government who protected him, and for whom he would get criminal associates to perform hits and other crimes, but these allegations were never substantiated. What happens now to the delicate balance of power amongst criminal gangs within Liberty City is unknown. It is unlikely to be pretty.
zh: 甘贝蒂犯罪家族的头目，乔恩･格拉韦利，昨晚在睡梦中安然离世，终年85岁。格拉韦利先生过去三年一直在舒特勒医疗中心住院。尽管地检署中有人认为住院是其回避庭审的诡计，但格拉韦利先生入院后从未离开医院。格拉韦利先生于1978年成为甘贝蒂犯罪家族的头目，在其管理下，该家族成为了自由城最强大的犯罪家族，与帕瓦诺家族分庭抗礼。尽管其已被指控多次，但格拉韦利先生从未被判任何重罪。有人认为政府内存在他的保护伞，为其实施谋杀等各类犯罪提供便利，但这些说法并未得到证实。自由城各大黑恶势力间的脆弱平衡或将发生变化，但很难向好发展。

english: A homeless Vietnam veteran, Jerry Kapowitz, has stumbled upon a haul of diamonds valued at over $2 million. They were in a small pouch amongst the rubble and trash at the Liberty City dump. Mr. Kapowitz had been living near the dump and surviving off of things he salvaged from there. "Before this, the best thing I'd found was a TV and that didn't even work," he told reporters. Mr. Kapowitz plans to take his newfound wealth down to Vice City where he will start a gun shop and liquor store, "They're real men down there and they need real guns and liquor in one convenient location." Mr. Kapowitz's ownership of the diamonds was immediately contested by over 100 people. Mayor Ochoa decided that it would be impossible to verify the claims so allowed Mr. Kapowitz to keep all of the proceeds from the diamonds' sale.
zh: 流浪的越战老兵杰里･卡波维茨捡到了价值超过两百万美元的钻石。这一小袋钻石竟然混在了自由城垃圾场的垃圾堆中。卡波维茨先生一直住在垃圾场附近，靠捡垃圾生存。「此前，我捡到过的最好的东西是一台电视，而且还是坏的，」他告诉记者。卡波维茨先生计划带着自己刚获得的财富去罪城，然后开一家枪店兼酒馆，「那边的人都是真汉子，他们需要一家同时具备真枪和好酒的店。」已有上百人对卡波维茨先生的钻石拥有权提出了异议，称自己是失主。奥乔亚市长则以无法证实失主为由，允许卡波维茨先生保留出售钻石所获得的收入。

english: The market has been chaotic recently. One day it's up, the next it's down. Now it's stabilized - it's started going steadily down. This makes it easier for people drawing graphs, if not for investors. It's been carnage on the market these past few days, but despite that, no one is dead. It's a metaphorical miracle, which is great for everyone apart from people who like watching snuff movies. But I digress - the economy is in free fall. People are out of jobs, and house prices are falling again. Worse, lots of rich people will see bonuses cut, but they are unlikely to have to forego that much.
zh: 近期股市震荡严重，涨一天，跌一天。但情况终于稳定了，股市稳步下跌。画走势图的人倒是省了不少麻烦，只要他画的图不是给股东看的。过去的几天是一场对股市的屠杀，不过并未出现死者，堪称奇迹，唯独对杀人实况片的爱好者是个坏消息。扯远了，经济正在自由落体，人们都在失业，房价不断下跌。更糟的是，许多富人会发现自己得到的分红减少，但这对他们似乎影响不大。

english: I know what I'm worth. I won't have no man try to get me cheap 'cause that would be wrong for him and wrong for me. If you get an amazing car cheap then you won't love it as much. You have to work to keep me. If you do that you'll get a beautiful woman who has class and likes a good time.
zh: 我很清楚我的价值，我不会让任何男人轻易得到我，那样于他于我都是错的，就跟白嫖来的豪车不可能被善待一样。得靠你的付出才能把我留住。付出够多，你就会得到一个端庄美丽而又喜欢玩乐的女人。

english: How much I've been given. I've had such a privileged life; I've been given so much that I feel guilty. I just want to give something back. I try to do that with my job and my charities. I hate conspicuous consumption and all that yuppie-scumbag shit. The three strikes law. Judges who don't give unlucky defendants a break. Republicans. Cheaters. Liars. Hypocrites. Etc. Etc. Etc.
zh:
我得到的给予之多。我如此优越的生活。我被给予了太多，多到令我内疚。我只想做出一些回报，于是我选择了现在的工作，资助了许多慈善机构。我讨厌炫耀性消费和那些白痴雅皮士。还讨厌三振出局法*、不给被告机会的法官、共和党人、骗子、伪君子，等等等等...
三振出局法：对严重的刑事累犯弃用常规量刑标准，延长其入狱服刑时间，最高可判处终身监禁。

english: Being held. Romantic movies. Sunsets in Middle Park.
zh: 被拥抱、浪漫电影、中央公园的夕阳。

english: ~z~Niko. The shit went down with those guys in Bohan. Elizabeta's doing a bid. I think she might have killed Manny.
zh: ~z~尼克，波汉那些人出事了。伊丽莎贝塔坐牢去了，我想她可能还杀了曼尼。

english: ~z~That's sad. I get close to a lot of people. Quickly.
zh: ~z~真可惜，我靠近过很多人，迅速地。

english: ~z~Just follow 'em. Take some photos. Text 'em to me.
zh: ~z~就是跟着他们，拍几张照，再发给我。

english: ~z~We did it. Top of the fucking world. Here's your share. Don't go spending it in any Italian restaurants.
zh: ~z~我们做到了，这他妈就是世界第一。这份是你的，不过别拿到意大利餐馆去花。

english: ~z~Shit, shit, shit, shit, shit. Michael. Dammit.
zh: ~z~操操操操操，迈克尔，我靠。

english: Mr. Dawkins, who has long attacked the gay community was himself revealed to be a practicing homosexual. That's his business. What is our business is the money he has stolen from the city. Rather than rehab he should be working on a chain gang. Mr. Dawkins is a typical conservative - hypocritical, repressed and corrupt. We just wish he would hurry up and resign.
zh: 常年抨击同性恋社群的道金斯先生被发现是同性恋。不过那是他的事，我们更关心他从本市偷走的钱。比起康复中心，他更应该去接受劳改。道金斯先生是典型的保守派——虚伪，压抑而腐败。我们只希望他能尽快辞职。

english: Great weed. Lumberjacks. A shitty military. Canada is beginning to look better every day for those of us who want to live a peaceful life composting our own shit, drinking fair trade coffee and preaching to everyone about the evils of plastic. With the passing of the US Jingoism Act, it is clear that many Americans are not welcome anymore. The founders of our country were noble men who, upon losing their teeth, did like George Washington and had new ones extracted from their slaves and implanted into their own. It's that kind of freedom that this country was founded on - freedom for some, tough luck for the rest. We're liberal, and it's our time to be on top next.
zh: 优质大麻、伐木工人、垃圾军队。对于我们中想要平静生活的人来说，加拿大的魅力与日俱增，你可以将自己的粪便用于施肥，喝公平贸易咖啡，向别人宣扬塑料的罪恶。在美国沙文主义法案通过后，显然会有许多人被「开除美籍」。我们国家的创立者都是贵族，在失去牙齿后，他们像乔治华盛顿一样从奴隶身上拔出新的牙齿，植入自己的口中。这就是作为本国根基的自由：少数人的自由，其他人的不幸。我们是自由主义者，该轮到我们做主了。

english: ~z~Argh. I was someone, you know. I made it. I changed the game.
zh: ~z~啊，怎么说我也是个人物。我做到了，我改变了游戏。

english: ~z~Alright. Bernie's place. Where was Bernie's place.
zh: ~z~好吧，伯尼的家，伯尼的家在哪儿来着。

english: ~z~Okay, Niko. It's over. It's all over now. Leave him there. We should go before anyone turns up.
zh: ~z~好了，尼克。结束了，现在都结束了。把他扔这儿吧，我们得在有人发现前离开。

english: ~z~all I hear about is Mr. Big, Mr. Roman, living the American dream.
zh: ~z~我读到的都是大腕先生，罗曼先生，活在美国梦里。

english: ~z~No. Mr. Bellic has stepped away from his office, can I take a message?
zh: ~z~不行，贝利克先生不在办公室，有什么需要我替您转达吗？

english: ~z~~x~Time for depressing song with Ms. Bluesy St. John.
zh: ~z~~x~接下来该是Bluesy St. John小姐的忧郁歌声时间了。

english: Again, Liberty City shakes with the sound of a large explosion. In response, our liberal Mayor, Julio Ochoa, has raised the terror threat level to Black 8. Residents of South Bohan would have been better off with a warning yesterday, Mr. Mayor. A Russian immigrant, Kenny Petrovic, owns the garage. Mr. Petrovic was unable to comment as we went to press. Why terrorists chose to target this business, we know not. But this does illustrate the point that no one is safe. The enemy can just as easily attack a privately-owned business as a national institution.
zh: 自由城再次发生爆炸事件，作为回应，我们的自由派市长胡里奥･奥乔亚将恐怖威胁等级提升至黑色级(8级)。早一天提醒南波汉的居民该多好啊，市长大人。爆炸发生在俄罗斯移民肯尼･彼得罗维奇的车库，截至发文，彼得罗维奇先生仍未对此事进行评论。我们并不知道恐怖分子将此作为袭击目标的原因，但这恰恰体现了人人都有危险。无论是私人物业还是国有设施，都有可能遭受袭击。

english: It's the taboo subject no one had thought of: Gays in the Fire Department. It's not a subject most people had worried about, but, according to Mr. Dawkins, the communal showers at most fire stations make men feel awkward. "Updating the showers to something where people can't openly stare longingly at each other's genitals would cost money and it's money I'd rather spend on protecting our city from terrorism," he said patriotically. And so say all of us. Thank you, Mr. Dawkins, for keeping it real.
zh: 这是一个没人想过的禁忌话题：消防队有基佬。大多数人不会考虑这一问题，但据道金斯先生所说，多数消防站采用的开放式公共浴室会让男人感到尴尬。他爱国地说：「如果要改造浴室，让使用者不能大大方方地眼馋别人的生殖器的话，改造所需的开销会很大，而我更愿意将这笔钱用于保护我们城市不受恐怖袭击。」我们深表同感。谢谢你，道金斯先生，谢谢你能保持真诚。

english: Worrying trends on the markets as the BAWSAQ refused to allow a discernible pattern to emerge. It went up and it went down and then it went nowhere. And we are not sure what to make of it; in a world in which no news is definitely bad news, especially for our ability to make money off this website. The fact is we'd like a pattern, as that would give us a story and currently we've got neither. It's a mess, and that makes it harder for people to say anything intelligent. Like when you vomit. It's not a bull, it's not a bear. It's a puddle of bile.
zh: 市场行情令人担忧，BAWSAQ大盘仍未给出明确走势。先是上涨，又是下跌，然后上下乱窜。我们不知道该怎么办，毕竟这个世界没有绝对的坏消息，而我们经营网站的目的也是为了营利。实际上我们都希望走势明确，因为这样我们还有故事能讲，但现在我们既看不清走势，又讲不出故事。实在是混乱，混乱到任何人都难以说出明智的话，就像你呕吐的时候。这不是牛市，也不是熊市，这就是一摊胆汁。

english: Liberty City's Deputy Police Commissioner, Francis McReary, was ruthlessly gunned down earlier. To most of us he is a hero, a man dedicated to serving the city who was taken before his time. Liberal "Blame America First" news outlets have been sullying the man's reputation. Rather than celebrate this patriot's great career, they dig up some unsubstantiated accusations of corruption. Francis McReary valiantly served Liberty City until he was murdered. We should remember him as an American Hero.
zh: 自由城的警局副局长弗朗西斯･麦克雷里于早些时候惨遭枪杀。对于我们大多数人来说，他是英雄，是一个为自由城勤恳奉献的人，但他却英年早逝。那些「凡事都怪美国」的自由派媒体一直在抹黑他，他们不去称赞这位爱国英雄的丰功伟绩，却在宣传无凭无据的贪污指控。弗朗西斯･麦克雷里为自由城鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已，我们应当把他当作美国英雄纪念。

english: Why do we think this? Mr. Dawkins admitted he took pity on Mr. Crane and gave him somewhere to stay. If this isn't an awful example of people expecting state handouts, I don't know what is. Quite frankly, I think we'd all prefer it if Mr. Crane was Mr. Dawkins' lover. It is an awful example to set. Pity is for the weak.
zh: 我们为什么会这样想？道金斯先生承认自己同情克兰先生，为其提供了住所。如果这都不算指望政府救济的人的实例，我都不知道怎么样才算了。不过老实说，如果克兰先生是道金斯先生的情人的话，那我们还是喜闻乐见的。这是个坏榜样，因为同情是给弱者的。

english: Why do we think this? Mr. Dawkins admitted he took pity on Mr. Crane and gave him somewhere to stay. If this isn't an awful example of people expecting state handouts, I don't know what is. Quite frankly, I think we'd all prefer it if Mr. Crane was Mr. Dawkins' lover. It is an awful example to set. Pity is for the weak.
zh: 我们为什么会这样想？道金斯先生承认自己同情克兰先生，为其提供了住所。如果这都不算指望政府救济的人的实例，我都不知道怎么样才算了。不过老实说，如果克兰先生是道金斯先生的情人的话，那我们还是喜闻乐见的。这是个坏榜样，因为同情是给弱者的。

english: He said what we all think and are afraid to admit - gay people cause terrorism. Not directly, of course, but by giving our enemies reason to hate us. Our enemies don't hate us because we bomb them or protect vicious absolute monarchies in oil rich states - that's left wing poppy cock. Our enemies hate us because we tolerate degenerates. You're who you are, and you do bad shit. and hanging out with you made me do bad shit, even though it ain't your fault. but i did bad shit to you, because you were my world. i thought you would kill me and you didn't. so that makes you a better person than some. i'm so glad we are friends now.

english: Dear mother, thank you for your e mail. I am always happy to hear from you. Your English is good. Better than mine. I am sorry I have not been much of a good son to you, and that I am not there to take care of you, but you know I cannot come back home. It would bring trouble, and unhappy memories for us both. Roman is well. He is living the American dream, mostly in his head, like all dream.
zh: 亲爱的妈妈，谢谢你给我发的电子邮件。我一直期待着能收到您的信。你的英语很好，比我的还好。 我很抱歉我一直没能当一个好儿子，并且我一直没能好好的照顾你， 但是你知道我不能回家了。那会带来麻烦，并且会给我们都带来不好的记忆。罗曼很好，他正生活在美国梦中， 绝大多数都在他的幻想中，就像所有的梦一样。

english: thank you for your e mail. It made me cry. At least you are well and happy. I know you cannot live here and be well. I hope happiness finds you. Look after cousin. He is good boy. I dream of both of you settling down with nice women. It is what his mother would have wanted, as well. I will write soon.
zh: 感谢你的来信。我哭了。 至少你过得很好并且很快乐。我知道你不能在这里平静的生活。我希望幸福能够找到你。 照顾你的堂兄吧。他是个好孩子。我梦见你们都和贤惠可人的女孩成家了，作为一个妈妈还能指望什么呢，保重，我很快还会再给你写信的。

zh: 世界不是我们想象的那样，我们信任的人其实是些人渣。我很想念吉姆，想念他超过一切。他才是真正的好汉，我们都想成为的好汉。

Mr. Stubbs, 83, was arriving in the city for a family meeting and to help to discuss bailing out a lot of rich people upset by the recent problems on the exchange. A passionate democrat when it suited him and also an elitist who hated poor people, Mr. Stubbs embodied an America that has mercifully disappeared. He was brutally killed standing up for freedom by a splinter cell now on the loose in Liberty City. Police are searching for the terror cell and advise people to be very afraid and report any activity by brown people.

People that run companies shouldn't get rich. We at PLO are all in favor of raising taxes. But when Big Business thinks it can start taxing our bodily functions, it's time to make a stand. Boycott the airlines. Take the bus. March on the White House. Wear sloganned t-shirts. Eat more sprouts. Your consumer choices CAN make a difference. The people still have the power. Honestly.

Fresh out of college, a place of learning, they want time to balance life by taking long hikes, getting colon cleansing, writing in a journal! How do we expect people to be part of a democracy when they are bogged down by oppressive work 8-9 hours a day? We feel sad for Sandra McColland, she's standing up for herself and fighting corporate America. Good for you. You go girl. These conservatives will take every ounce of your being. Sue them till they get a clue that work is about more than working.

english: Ten drunken genetic aberrations left on an island in the Indian Ocean to survive without food, clothes or a moral code. Confused? You should be. And so were all the children who watched this gender-bending freak fest. Thankfully, CNT confirmed today that Hermaphrodite Island will not be returning for a second season. This circus side show was a prime example of the depths to which television has sunk. In the old days, babies with manginas were taken quietly outside and thrown down the well. Well, times have changed. We know that these 'people' can't help the fact that they were born to sin. But what kind of message does it send out when we parade them in front of our kids at 7pm on a Saturday night? Is it any wonder that degenerate behavior continues to thrive among the youth of today? Shemales and ladyboys cavorting around in their underwear. This isn't Thailand. The producers should be ashamed of themselves.

He believes that the constant rumors about his finances, his immigration status, his wife, his experiences back in Russia and every other aspect of his life have been spread by people wanting to take over his business interests in both Russia and the US and in particular take control of the rampage. Mr. Ashvilli is 100% focused on the season ahead. League officials are still trying to discover is Mr. Ashvilli passes their test of being a person fit for owning a franchise, while formal investigations into Mr. Ashvilli's finances are on going.
zh: 「阿什维利先生致力于建设暴怒队。他是冰球运动的忠实粉丝，迁居自由城后的生活也幸福美满。他认为，长期流传的关于其经济状况、移民状态、家庭、在俄罗斯时的经历等生活状态的谣言，都是由美俄两国觊觎其商业利益的小人散布的，尤其是那些觊觎暴怒队的家伙。阿什维利先生正全心全意地关注着即将到来的新赛季。」冰球联盟仍在尝试调查阿什维利能否通过球队经营者的资质审查。同时，此前关于阿什维利经济状况的调查也还在进行当中。

english: A homeless Vietnam veteran, Jerry Kapowitz, has stumbled upon a haul of diamonds valued at over $2 million. They were in a small pouch amongst the trash in Meadows Park. Mr. Kapowitz had been living near the dump and surviving off of things he salvaged from there. "Before this, the best thing I'd found was a TV and that didn't even work," he told reporters. Mr. Kapowitz plans to take his newfound wealth down to Vice City where he will start a gun shop and liquor store, "They're real men down there and they need real guns and liquor in one convenient location." Mr. Kapowitz's ownership of the diamonds was immediately contested by over 100 people. Mayor Ochoa decided that it would be impossible to verify the claims so allowed Mr. Kapowitz to keep all of the proceeds from the diamonds' sale.

english: Mob Boss, Jon Gravelli, alleged head of the Gambetti crime family, died peacefully in his sleep last night. Mr. Gravelli, 85, had been residing at the Schottler Medical Center for the last 3 years. Although some in the DA's office argued that this was a ruse to avoid a court case, Mr. Gravelli never left hospital after being admitted. Mr. Gravelli has been head of the Gambetti crime syndicate since 1978 and under his stewardship, the family had become the most powerful of Liberty City's crime families, rivaling the Pavano family. Although he had been indicted several times, Mr. Gravelli was never convicted of a serious crime. Some believed he had contacts within the government who protected him, and for whom he would get criminal associates to perform hits and other crimes, but these allegations were never substantiated. What happens now to the delicate balance of power amongst criminal gangs within Liberty City is unknown. It is unlikely to be pretty.
zh: 被认为是甘贝蒂犯罪家族头目的黑帮老大，乔恩･格拉韦利，昨晚在睡梦中安然离世。85岁的格拉韦利先生过去三年一直住在舒特勒医疗中心。尽管地检署中有人认为住院是其回避庭审的诡计，但格拉韦利先生在住院后的确从未离开医院。格拉韦利先生自1978年起担任甘贝蒂犯罪家族的头目，在其管理下，该家族成为了自由城最强大的犯罪家族，与帕瓦诺家族分庭抗礼。尽管其已被指控多次，但格拉韦利先生从未被判任何重罪。有人认为政府内存在他的保护伞，为其实施谋杀等各类犯罪提供便利，但这些说法并未得到证实。自由城各大犯罪势力间的脆弱平衡或将发生变化，但很难向好发展。

Sue them till they get a clue that work is about more than working.
zh: 广大落魄的美国大学生加入劳动大军时所遇到的是血汗工厂。刚从大学这片知识天地毕业的他们，需要时间远足、洗肠、写日记，借此平来衡生活！如果人们被每天八九个小时的强制劳动绑架，他们还怎么参与到民主社会当中？桑德拉･麦科兰为自己发声，并与美国企业界进行抗争，我们为她的遭遇感到难过。你真行，加油姑娘。这些保守派会榨干你的每分每毫。起诉他们，让他们认清劳动不仅仅是干活。
